algorithm: Ed25519 over the payload UTF-8; did:key is the public half (multicodec ed25519-pub, base58btc).
verify: Recompute sha256 of provenance/report.json and provenance/snapshot.json, rebuild the payload as technocore-census|report.json:sha256:<report>|snapshot.json:sha256:<snapshot>, decode the did:key to the raw Ed25519 key, then verify the base64url signature over the payload UTF-8. No private key needed.
living_data: This signature attests one frozen release, provenance/*.json, captured 2026-08-27T12:56:49Z. data/*.json is a living feed the daily CI refresh rewrites as the network grows; each refresh is a reproducible github-actions[bot] commit derived from its own committed data/snapshot.json, so it needs no re-signing. The key never runs in CI.
